safety_review_metadata.phase: Phase 7A.1 — Resolve Patch Safety Questions Before Authorization

count_reconciliation.summary: All reported counts are verified as exact, mutually exclusive partitions across cohorts.

key_constants_explained.1621_post_failure_normal: Sum of post-all-failure Normal windows across all 4 splits: 1130 (train) + 197 (val) + 145 (test) + 149 (confirmatory) = 1621.
key_constants_explained.149_confirmatory_post_failure_normal: Windows labeled Normal in confirmatory holdout occurring after all failures of an entity (41 entities).
key_constants_explained.7_cross_history_normal: Windows labeled Normal in confirmatory holdout occurring between failures in tasks 6224307516_2 (4 windows) and 6224307516_3 (3 windows) whose 5-step trailing history spans across failure 1.
key_constants_explained.156_confirmatory_contaminated_normal: Sum of 149 post-all-failure Normal + 7 cross-history Normal = 156.
key_constants_explained.196_confirmatory_affected_all_labels: All windows in confirmatory holdout occurring after at least one failure event: 149 (post-fail normal) + 7 (cross-history normal) + 14 (warning) + 26 (critical) = 196.

patch_verification_code_audit.event_classifier_v2_v3: VERIFIED_CORRECT. Uses self.event_cls.FAIL which resolves to 3 in 2011 trace and 5 in 2019 trace.
patch_verification_code_audit.null_nan_safety: VERIFIED_CORRECT. Adds explicit guard: if pd.isna(t) or not np.isfinite(t): return FailureLabel.UNKNOWN, None.
patch_verification_code_audit.boundary_collision_t_equals_fail: VERIFIED_CORRECT. Uses time_sec <= t, correctly marking concurrent failure (tau=0.0s) as UNKNOWN (-1).
patch_verification_code_audit.preservation_of_valid_prefailure: VERIFIED_CORRECT. For t < T_fail, prior_fails is empty, preserving all Critical, Warning, Normal, Finish, Kill, Evict semantics.
patch_verification_code_audit.pipeline_exclusion_mechanism: VERIFIED_CORRECT. In WindowGenerator(exclude_unknown=True), line 80 checks target_label == FailureLabel.UNKNOWN and continues, excluding the window from X, y, and metadata.

policy_a_terminal_entity.definition: Any observation timestamp t >= T_fail_1 is permanently censored as FailureLabel.UNKNOWN (-1).
policy_a_terminal_entity.source_text: Protocol Amendment 2.1 line 201 ('post-failure step -> label -1 (strictly excluded)'); cohort_verification.json line 92; reports/phase6_1_cohort_verification.md line 93.
policy_a_terminal_entity.implication: Mathematically guarantees that zero windows cross a failure event, because any window with history crossing a failure must have t_pred >= T_fail and is therefore dropped.

policy_b_segmented_episodes.definition: Permits pre-failure alerts for subsequent failure episodes (T_fail_2) if an explicit scheduler restart occurred and the trailing 5-step history does not cross T_fail_1.
policy_b_segmented_episodes.limitation_in_current_code: WindowGenerator does NOT check history labels. If an endpoint is given label 1 or 2, WindowGenerator will construct the window even if its history crosses an earlier failure. Implementing Policy B requires modifying WindowGenerator to check history spans.
policy_b_segmented_episodes.confirmatory_impact: 156 windows excluded; 5,355 clean windows retained (the Phase 6.8 Scenario 3 cohort).

regression_tests_validation.production_execution: CONFIRMED. Imports TargetLabelGenerator directly from src.labeling.target_generator.

window_generator.history_check: DOES NOT CHECK history labels. Under Policy A, this is safe because no post-failure step can be an endpoint. Under Policy B, WindowGenerator would need a history-crossing guard.

feature_engineer.operators: Strictly trailing operators (shift, diff, rolling.mean, slope). Zero forward-looking operators.
feature_engineer.leakage_to_prefailure: ZERO. Pre-failure feature values at t < T_fail are mathematically identical whether post-failure telemetry exists or is removed.
feature_engineer.regeneration_required: Features do not need formula re-engineering. Only WindowGenerator must be re-run on corrected labels to generate clean X and y arrays.

required_specifications_before_patching: Explicitly ratify Policy A (Terminal Entity Lifecycle) as the governing policy for Phase 7A diagnostic datasets.
Do NOT overwrite data/processed/l5/ or results/phase6/. All corrected outputs must be written to data/processed/phase7a_diagnostic/ and results/phase7a/.
Update tests/test_phase7a_labeling_repair.py to test both unit-level TargetLabelGenerator and tensor-level WindowGenerator history invariants.
Preserve historical Phase 6.4 evaluation verdict as permanently NO_OPERATIONAL_WINNER.
